about_the_game:
World of Warships: Legends

World of Warships: Legends is a free-to-play online naval shooter you can play across Steam, consoles, and mobile devices. Jump into dynamic battles aboard legendary 20th-century warships and enjoy fast-paced combat with smooth, intuitive controls! 

Cross-Platform

Team up with your friends on PC, console, phone, or tablet. Dive into epic team battles and rule the seas together!

Accessible and Rewarding Gameplay

Enjoy smooth, controller-friendly gameplay that's easy to pick up—but challenging enough to keep you coming back for more. 

Unique Commanders System

Collect over 100 commanders with historical and fictional backgrounds. Level them up and create unique builds to match your battle strategy. 

Regular Updates

Get regular free updates and explore fresh content, new campaigns, special events, and exciting collaborations. 

Fast, Action-Packed Battles

Take on thrilling sea battles against real players or bots. Enjoy quick, action-packed matches or try out other game modes. 

Legendary Warships

Take the helm of over 500 historical warships from the 20th century's most powerful navies, including the USA, USSR, UK, Germany, and Japan. 

Various Playstyles

Choose between destroyers, cruisers, battleships, and aircraft carriers — including subtypes like hybrids, heavy brawlers, and more. Each ship offers a unique playstyle and abilities! 

  • Dynamic, easy-to-learn online action against real players 

  • Cross-platform support

  • Optimized console-style controls, fine-tuned for the PC version 

  • Special events and exciting collaborations 

  • Unique Commanders system 

  • A vast collection of carefully recreated historical warships from nations like the USA, USSR, Germany, Japan, and more

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10, Windows® 11, 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700/Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1650 (4GB) /AMD Radeon RX 570 (4GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 45 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10, Windows® 11, 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700/AMD Ryzen 5 7600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce RTX 2060 (6GB) /AMD RX 5600 XT (6GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 45 GB available space

short_description: Join this free-to-play PvP online naval shooter with fast-paced combat, easy-to-learn gameplay, intuitive controls, and cross-platform play on Steam, console, and mobile. Choose from 500+ warships and 100+ Commanders, and master tactics on diverse maps. Play now and become a legend!
